scope.description: Four cases of the sealed-partition five-node history in one harness: (TrailingLogs=0, no post-snapshot entries), (10,20), (25,20) and a backlog case (TrailingLogs=2, SnapshotThreshold=5, 15 ms-per-apply FSM, 60 uncommitted commands on the peer, the leader snapping on its own while its log runs ahead of its FSM).
assumptions: The backlog case meets the compacted-boundary condition when the leader's snapshot index is below its retained store's first index.
Counting Restore calls identifies InstallSnapshot installs without touching production logic.
Precondition guards skip rather than fail.
excluded: No network transport; the peer's own snapshotting under the shared small SnapshotThreshold is not disabled.

basis.prefix: For each case, MakeClusterCustom(Peers=5, Bootstrap=true, Conf{TrailingLogs, SnapshotThreshold 1<<20 or 5, SnapshotInterval 1h or 10ms, HeartbeatTimeout/ElectionTimeout/LeaderLeaseTimeout 1s}, MakeFSMFunc returning a Restore-counting MockFSM, wrapped in a 15 ms-per-apply slow FSM for the backlog case). Isolate {leader, partner} from the other three in both directions; replicate `uncommitted` commands from the leader to the partner only; wait for a successor among the others; for non-backlog cases apply one command and take a user snapshot at the log end, for the backlog case fire 60 applies without waiting and wait for the leader's own snapshot index to become non-zero; apply `post` further commands; heal with FullyConnect; sample each node's state, indexes and store bounds plus the partner's Restore count over about 1.5 s.
